releases.summary: A new website (Vue), Done by for who does each step with capacity counting only named equipment, project plans in days with dates, milestones as 0-second moments, and Microsoft SQL Server as a database option.

Variables below the chart, and formulas in durations (=[Weld time]*1.5) that work out again when a variable changes. Rows that touch the row they follow now stay touching when it gets shorter or moves.

Process builder (welding, laser, dispensing, screwdriving, press, vision), Pick & place for any kind of robot, capacity with what-ifs (2-up, a second robot) and feeder checks, payload and safety margins, adding steps below the selected row, the editor's theme on every page, shared libraries between laptops and the server, and Linux installer fixes.
First release: install with Docker or Podman, chart revisions and reviews, move builders, compare, and offline work with a company server.
